title: The Last Orbit Again
author: Ines Oyelaran
blurb: Beatrix Marchetti, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
